newsitem.title: INDIA: At least 25 feared drowned in Indian river crash.
newsitem.headline: At least 25 feared drowned in Indian river crash.

text.p: At least 25 people were feared drowned when a tractor towing passengers on a trailer skidded off a bridge into a swollen river in the western Indian state of Maharashtra, the Press Trust of India (PTI) said on Thursday.
Nine bodies had been recovered from the Nandini river near Ahmednagar, some 200 km (125 miles) from the state capital of Bombay, after the accident on Wednesday, the news agency said.
Around 40 villagers were travelling in the trailer, it said. Fifteen people had swum ashore from the river swollen by monsoon floods, the news agency said.
